title: Appeals and Grievances Standing Schedule: Filers and Representative Appointments
content:
Standing to file an Appeals and Grievances case, and the paperwork a third-party filer needs, differ by tier. The schedule entries are:

- *Who may file*: the filers who have standing for the tier.
- *Appointment of representative required*: whether a filing by someone other than the beneficiary needs an appointment of representative on file.
- *Appointment window*: calendar days after filing within which a missing appointment of representative must arrive (0 means not applicable).
- *Participating provider files in its own right*: whether a participating provider may file in its own right.

| Tier | Who may file | Appointment of representative required | Appointment window (calendar days) | Participating provider files in its own right |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | beneficiary; parent or guardian; appointed representative; participating provider | yes | 30 | yes |
| Beneficiary Grievance | beneficiary; parent or guardian; appointed representative | yes | 30 | no |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | beneficiary; parent or guardian; appointed representative; participating provider | yes | 30 | yes |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | beneficiary; parent or guardian; appointed representative | yes | 30 | no |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | beneficiary; parent or guardian; appointed representative; participating provider | yes | 30 | yes |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | beneficiary; parent or guardian; appointed representative; participating provider | yes | 1 | yes |

**Notes to the schedule**

- The appointment window is 30 calendar days on five tiers and 1 calendar day on the Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration.
- A participating provider is a filer with standing on the Allowable Charge Review, the Claim Factual Reconsideration, the Medical Necessity Reconsideration and the Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration; on the Beneficiary Grievance and the Enrollment Reinstatement Review it is not listed among those who may file.
- Every tier requires an appointment of representative for a filing by someone other than the beneficiary.
